He is smiling and holding two rectangular cosmetic bottles, one light blue and one grey, against a neutral indoor background with soft, warm lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the light blue foundation stick, labeled 'MEN FOUNDATION SLIMTICK'. The man's hands, adorned with a bracelet and ring, rotate the base to reveal the beige product. (3) He applies the foundation stick directly to his left cheek in a smooth motion. He then flips the stick to reveal a black built-in brush on the other end, using it to blend the product into his skin with small, circular motions. (4) A new product, 'MEN SLIM FIT COVER LOTION', is introduced in a close-up. The man squeezes a small amount of the beige liquid onto the back of his hand and then uses his fingers to dot it onto his face. (5) The final phase shows the man applying contour with a large fluffy brush to his jawline. He holds both bottles up again, smiling broadly at the camera to showcase the completed natural-looking makeup finish.
